---
title: "Ethical Issues"
---

Click on an option to explore its ethical analysis and impacts.

<div class="accordion" id="ethicalOptions">

<!-- Option 1 -->
<div class="accordion-item">
<h2 class="accordion-header">
<button class="accordion-button collapsed"
style="background-color:#7c2d12; color:white;"
data-bs-toggle="collapse"
data-bs-target="#option1">
Option 1: Allow AI Use With Disclosure
</button>
</h2>

<div id="option1" class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#ethicalOptions">
<div class="accordion-body">

<p>Applicants are allowed to use AI tools as long as they clearly disclose how AI was used in their application materials.</p>

<p><strong>Pros</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Improves efficiency in resume screening</li>
<li>Encourages transparency in applications</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Cons</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>May reduce originality and critical thinking</li>
<li>AI bias could affect screening outcomes</li>
<li>Could disadvantage applicants without AI access</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Impact on Stakeholders</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Applicants may feel pressure to use AI tools</li>
<li>HR must enforce disclosure rules</li>
<li>Reviewers may still struggle with trust in resumes</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Ethical Frameworks</strong></p>

<p><strong>Utilitarianism:</strong> Increases efficiency and clarity, but may introduce inequality and bias depending on AI access and model quality.</p>

<p><strong>Deontology:</strong> Supports honesty and fairness through disclosure requirements, but relies heavily on compliance.</p>

<p><strong>Virtue Ethics:</strong> Encourages honesty and responsibility, though it may weaken personal effort and creativity.</p>

</div>
</div>
</div>


<!-- Option 2 -->
<div class="accordion-item">
<h2 class="accordion-header">
<button class="accordion-button collapsed"
style="background-color:#065f46; color:white;"
data-bs-toggle="collapse"
data-bs-target="#option2">
Option 2: AI Allowed Only for Grammar and Translation
</button>
</h2>

<div id="option2" class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#ethicalOptions">
<div class="accordion-body">

<p>AI tools may only be used for grammar correction and language translation, not for generating content or rewriting experience descriptions.</p>

<p><strong>Pros</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Reduces overreliance on AI</li>
<li>Supports non-native English speakers</li>
<li>Maintains fairness while allowing accessibility support</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Cons</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Hard to monitor compliance</li>
<li>May slow down application review processes slightly</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Impact on Stakeholders</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Applicants retain basic AI support</li>
<li>HR gets clearer usage guidelines</li>
<li>AI companies may see reduced usage</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Ethical Frameworks</strong></p>

<p><strong>Utilitarianism:</strong> Balances fairness and accessibility while preserving human authorship of ideas.</p>

<p><strong>Deontology:</strong> Creates a clear rule for acceptable AI use and promotes fairness.</p>

<p><strong>Virtue Ethics:</strong> Encourages responsibility, honesty, and self-development.</p>

</div>
</div>
</div>


<!-- Option 3 -->
<div class="accordion-item">
<h2 class="accordion-header">
<button class="accordion-button collapsed"
style="background-color:#1e3a8a; color:white;" 
data-bs-toggle="collapse"
data-bs-target="#option3">
Option 3: No AI Use Allowed
</button>
</h2>

<div id="option3" class="accordion-collapse collapse" data-bs-parent="#ethicalOptions">
<div class="accordion-body">

<p>All AI use is prohibited for both applicants and resume reviewers throughout the hiring process.</p>

<p><strong>Pros</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Encourages original thinking and authenticity</li>
<li>Ensures equal rules for all applicants</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Cons</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Increases workload for reviewers</li>
<li>Disadvantages non-native speakers</li>
<li>Removes useful accessibility tools</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Impact on Stakeholders</strong></p>
<ul>
<li>Applicants must rely entirely on their own writing skills</li>
<li>HR and reviewers face higher workload</li>
</ul>

<p><strong>Ethical Frameworks</strong></p>

<p><strong>Utilitarianism:</strong> Preserves authenticity but may reduce overall efficiency and accessibility.</p>

<p><strong>Deontology:</strong> Ensures equal treatment but removes potentially helpful tools.</p>

<p><strong>Virtue Ethics:</strong> Strongly supports independence, effort, and authenticity.</p>

</div>
</div>
</div>

</div>
